finding: Universal nuclear gate crossproduct is the largest waste pattern.
proposed_change: Split nuclear_assurance_gate into gate_library, gate_applicability_by_service_family, and local_evidence_status. Generate all-gate views only for QA, not as primary CSV artifacts.
expected_benefit: Large size reduction, clearer semantics, faster review.
risk_if_unfixed: Every new gate multiplies package size and makes non-applicable gaps look real.
rev0307_note: Normalized service-family and gate-applicability rule layer added; old giant matrices preserved for compatibility but demoted by audit.

finding: Rule catalog and schema/catalog tables can drift while validation still passes.
proposed_change: Add a single build/validate script that regenerates validation-rules, table catalogs, file-core, resource-manifest, and validation reports in one transaction.
expected_benefit: Prevents stale metadata and makes revision claims reproducible.
risk_if_unfixed: Future users trust green checks that are checking yesterday’s cube.

finding: Emergency preparedness source base is good but too compressed into broad source pages.
proposed_change: Register standalone sources for RG 1.101 Rev. 7, 10 CFR 50.47, 10 CFR 50.160, 10 CFR 50.54(q), NUREG-0654/FEMA-REP-1 Rev. 2, evacuation time estimate guidance, and risk communication guidance.
expected_benefit: Sharper traceability from gates to binding/accepted methods.
risk_if_unfixed: Broad URLs hide which version or method a gate relies on.

finding: The current gates mention EPZ, evacuation, KI, medical response and recovery but need a more explicit 16-planning-standards crosswalk.
proposed_change: Add nuclear_ep_16_planning_standard_crosswalk.csv mapping each 10 CFR 50.47(b) planning standard to gates, evidence tables, exercise objectives, and maturity caps.
risk_if_unfixed: Gates look plausible but not directly auditable against the canonical planning standards.
rev0307_note: 16 planning-standard crosswalk added; local/site evidence still required.

finding: SMR/ONT emergency planning is not just a small version of large LWR EPZ planning.
proposed_change: Add a separate performance-based EP branch for 10 CFR 50.160/RG 1.242 with scalable plume EPZ basis, hazard analysis, drills/exercises, ingestion response capabilities, and public communication constraints.
expected_benefit: Avoids over- or under-applying large-LWR assumptions to advanced reactors.
risk_if_unfixed: The model may either overburden lower-source-term designs or understate offsite capability needs.

finding: Protective-action gates need richer decision quality, not only existence of routes and alerts.
proposed_change: Add fields for meteorology/dose-model provenance, uncertainty bands, shelter-versus-evacuation tradeoff, staged evacuation, shadow evacuation, route impediments, concurrent wildfire/flood/heat, and communication loss.
expected_benefit: Turns plans into operational decision tests.
risk_if_unfixed: Template evidence may pass while real protective action remains brittle.
rev0307_note: EPZ operational evidence variables and compound-disaster loadcases added.

finding: KI is present, but medical response should distinguish thyroid blocking from decontamination, decorporation, biodosimetry, trauma/burn mass casualty, behavioral health, and long-term registry.
proposed_change: Add medical_countermeasure_subtype and population_monitoring_registry gates with REMM/CDC/NASEM evidence.
expected_benefit: Reduces KI overfocus and improves medical realism.
risk_if_unfixed: Public guidance could overemphasize KI and underprepare for other radionuclide/medical needs.
rev0307_note: KI anti-theater guardrail and medical/recovery evidence tables added.

finding: Recovery/claims path exists but needs liability, documentation, dose records, relocation, property, employment, school continuity and mental-health follow-up interfaces.
expected_benefit: Makes recovery auditable rather than a postscript.
risk_if_unfixed: People can be protected during the plume phase and abandoned in recovery.
rev0307_note: Population monitoring, claims, cleanup, relocation, legal aid and trust-repair evidence table added.

finding: Security-sensitive details are properly redacted in principle, but the redaction taxonomy is not machine-tested against every table.
proposed_change: Add a publication-control linter for route timing, vulnerabilities, personal/medical registry data, security response details, and facility weakness strings.
expected_benefit: Lets public scorecards exist without leaking sensitive operational details.
risk_if_unfixed: Either oversharing creates risk or over-redaction destroys public challenge value.

finding: The source register has reviewed_window fields, but no URL-status/freshness audit artifact.
proposed_change: Add source_freshness_audit.csv with checked_at, HTTP/status/manual_review, current_version, superseded_by, and next_review_due.
risk_if_unfixed: Current-looking source rows silently go stale.
rev0307_note: Source-freshness audit added for key emergency-prep sources touched in this revision.

finding: New specialist gates could still be added later without a service-family applicability rule.
proposed_change: Add a validation rule that every nuclear-assurance-gate row has exactly one gate-applicability-rule row and no new gate can default to all floors unless tagged universal_core with justification.
expected_benefit: Prevents recurrence of the universal crossproduct defect.
risk_if_unfixed: The next revision can accidentally recreate all-gate sprawl.

finding: The cube now knows which gates are applicable by family, but still lacks local evidence status rows by site/project/jurisdiction.
proposed_change: Create nuclear-local-evidence-status.csv with site_id, project_id, jurisdiction_id, gate_id, evidence_artifact, freshness, owner, exercise_result, maturity cap and counterevidence status.
expected_benefit: Separates template applicability from actual readiness.
risk_if_unfixed: Users may confuse applicable template gates with proven local controls.
rev0307_note: next substantive layer after applicability normalization

finding: Compound-disaster loadcases are present as candidates, but exercise outcomes are not captured.
proposed_change: Create nuclear-emergency-exercise-outcome.csv with loadcase_id, objective_id, tested_date, pass/fail, deficiency, corrective-action owner, due date and retest evidence.
expected_benefit: Turns loadcases into corrective-action closure instead of scenario prose.
risk_if_unfixed: The cube gains better scenarios but still cannot prove the drills changed readiness.
